from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzz/rpc_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"data,size","code":"p11_buffer_add (&buffer, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into the RPC buffer and become the server input stream."},
  {"step":2,"file":"p11-kit/rpc-server.c","function":"p11_rpc_server_handle","line":621,"var":"attrs,n_attrs","code":"IN_ATTRIBUTE_ARRAY(attrs, n_attrs) -> proto_read_attribute_array (msg, &attrs, &n_attrs);","note":"The request dispatch for attribute-array arguments routes the input to the attribute-array parser."},
  {"step":3,"file":"p11-kit/rpc-server.c","function":"proto_read_attribute_array","line":292,"var":"n_attrs","code":"p11_rpc_buffer_get_uint32 (msg->input, &msg->parsed, &n_attrs)","note":"The first attacker-controlled field selects how many CK_ATTRIBUTE entries will be parsed and allocated."},
  {"step":4,"file":"p11-kit/rpc-server.c","function":"proto_read_attribute_array","line":295,"var":"attrs","code":"attrs = p11_rpc_message_alloc_extra_array (msg, n_attrs, sizeof (CK_ATTRIBUTE));","note":"The parser allocates storage for the top-level attribute array based on the supplied count."},
  {"step":5,"file":"p11-kit/rpc-server.c","function":"proto_read_attribute_array","line":300,"var":"temp","code":"p11_rpc_buffer_get_attribute (msg->input, &offset, &temp);","note":"Each element is first decoded into a temporary CK_ATTRIBUTE to learn its type and encoded length."},
  {"step":6,"file":"p11-kit/rpc-message.c","function":"p11_rpc_buffer_get_attribute","line":1244,"var":"attr->ulValueLen","code":"if (!validity) { attr->ulValueLen = ((CK_ULONG)-1); ... }","note":"A nested attribute can be marked invalid or valid; valid entries continue into value decoding."},
  {"step":7,"file":"p11-kit/rpc-message.c","function":"p11_rpc_buffer_get_attribute","line":1257,"var":"attr->pValue,attr->ulValueLen","code":"if (!serializer->decode (buffer, offset, attr->pValue, &attr->ulValueLen)) return false;","note":"For array-typed attributes, the serializer decodes the nested value and reports its decoded length."},
  {"step":8,"file":"p11-kit/rpc-message.c","function":"p11_rpc_buffer_get_attribute_array_value","line":1112,"var":"value_length","code":"*value_length = count * sizeof (CK_ATTRIBUTE);","note":"When an attribute value itself is an array, the helper reports only count*sizeof(CK_ATTRIBUTE), not the true serialized byte size of nested attributes."},
  {"step":9,"file":"p11-kit/rpc-server.c","function":"proto_read_attribute_array","line":304,"var":"attrs[i].pValue","code":"attrs[i].pValue = p11_rpc_message_alloc_extra (msg, temp.ulValueLen);","note":"The server allocates the destination buffer using the reported ulValueLen, so an underestimated nested-array length can mis-size the storage used for the attribute value."},
  {"step":10,"file":"p11-kit/rpc-server.c","function":"proto_read_attribute_array","line":305,"var":"attrs[i]","code":"p11_rpc_buffer_get_attribute (msg->input, &offset2, &attrs[i]);","note":"The nested attribute is then decoded into the allocated buffer, creating the memory-safety sink when the buffer is too small for the actual nested data."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
